title: Odd Even Jump
description: Determine how many starting indices allow you to reach the end of the array by alternating between odd-numbered jumps (smallest larger value) and even-numbered jumps (largest smaller value).

steps.note: Initialize arrays to track reachable states from index i for odd (higher) and even (lower) jumps.
Last index is always reachable for both types of jumps.
Start iteration from second to last element.
For arr[1]=13, no value >= 13 exists to the right. higher[1] = false.
For arr[1]=13, largest value <= 13 is 12 at index 2. lower[1] = higher[2] (true).
For arr[0]=10, smallest value >= 10 is 12 at index 2. higher[0] = lower[2] (true).
For arr[0]=10, no value <= 10 exists to the right. lower[0] = false.
